description: The pie chart illustrates the time distribution across two primary components of the Paper Copilot system, with the total time broken down into two distinct segments. The largest segment, colored orange, represents the "Reduction" phase, accounting for 60.9 seconds, which corresponds to 69.92% of the total time. The second segment, colored blue, represents "Efficient deployment," contributing 26.2 seconds, or 30.08% of the total. The chart visually emphasizes the "Reduction" phase as the dominant component, with its slice significantly larger than that of "Efficient deployment." The percentages are clearly labeled within each slice, and the chart includes a legend to associate the colors with their respective categories. The overall layout is simple and focused on comparing the relative time spent on these two processes.
